mathematics.assertion_tested: Derive the generic IC4 metric Legendre map and functional auxiliary jets; construct IC5's exact nonlinear auxiliary square and covariant phase action; derive the IC6 tensor-balanced revision, its actual isotropic TT equations and homogeneous constraint tangent, and solve each revision's own nonuniform auxiliary equations. Tests do not certify the complete gravity theory.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact real symbolic SymPy; fixed ell=ln(9/5), Tcal=-27/16+54/(5ell). Double-precision variational periodic-grid corroboration with analytic differentiated discrete gradients/Hessians.
mathematics.conventions: Signature -+++; m,kappa,a0>0; timelike varied clock, unitary T=t for canonical reduction. One physical matter metric. Smooth auxiliary 0<u<1. Distinct IC4, IC5 and IC6 action IDs; transfers require the proved comparisons, not common filenames.
inputs: IC4 explicit action and frozen raw quadratic calculations

bounds.symbolic: Generic positive-definite barred 3-metric and six symmetric velocities for IC4, tK!=0; separate conditional auxiliary operator domain. IC5 square is exact on |r^2-1|<1/4. IC6 TT calculation: flat homogeneous isotropic backgrounds with J_T>0, physical time/length retained; not arbitrary inhomogeneous characteristics.
bounds.functional: IC5 weak linearized coercivity on a smooth torus, H1_s plus L2_t, with the report's explicit coefficient/gradient bounds; full Poisson-operator composition domain and evolution regularity not proved.
bounds.numeric: Three periodic grids N=16,32,64 on [0,2pi), m=h0=V=1,kappa=6; trace pi=-3exp(-1/2); TT momentum diag(epsilon cosz,-epsilon cosz,0),epsilon=0.035. Newton residual target1e-11, <=16 steps, <=14 line-search halvings. Actual IC5 and IC6 densities solved separately. Floating lower rectangle estimate for IC6 J_T, not interval arithmetic.
bounds.resource_caps: 180s wall per primary/suite run, <=1048576 log bytes, one cooperative BLAS/OpenMP thread per process. Parallel independent processes; no OS memory/affinity guarantee.
